behavior_vs_demographic.interpretation: Low ARI(behavior, behavior+demo) means age/gender/district would rewrite segments if included — supporting the champion's behavior-only feature set. High ARI would mean demographics are mostly redundant with behavior.
behavior_vs_demographic.driver_audit: Champion clustering inputs remain the 8 CRM behavioral/product features. Demographics are post-hoc ablation / fairness monitors only.

risk_register.risk: Using segments for credit eligibility or pricing
risk_register.why: Unsupervised clusters are not probability-of-default models
risk_register.mitigation: Forbid eligibility/pricing use; require supervised risk models + policy

risk_register.risk: Over-contacting dormant or stressed customers with sales
risk_register.why: Wrong play drives complaints and harm
risk_register.mitigation: Decision map guardrails + hard suppress lists by segment

risk_register.risk: Treating stressed segment as undeserving of inclusion products
risk_register.why: Negative balance is a care signal, not a moral label
risk_register.mitigation: Hardship / budgeting pathways; ban investment pitches

risk_register.risk: Geographic proxy discrimination via district concentration
risk_register.why: District may correlate with socioeconomic status
risk_register.mitigation: Monitor district concentration; do not target by region from segment ID alone

risk_register.risk: Owner vs disponent confusion on joint accounts
risk_register.why: Berka is account-grain; disp can attach multiple people
risk_register.mitigation: Account-level CRM only until explicit owner policy exists

risk_register.risk: Tiny segments (stressed / dormant) driving unstable ops policy
risk_register.why: Small n → noisy centroids and overfit plays
risk_register.mitigation: Human review queue; do not automate high-stakes actions on tiny cells

risk_register.risk: Historical Czech 1990s context generalized as modern policy
risk_register.why: Currency levels and era do not transfer
risk_register.mitigation: Treat segments as behavioral types; revalidate on current book

usage_constraints: Allowed: CRM content targeting, journey design, service prioritization with guardrails
Forbidden: credit eligibility, pricing, collections aggression from segment ID alone
Required: human review for stressed + low-confidence members
limitations: Age/gender are ablation features only — not in the champion clustering matrix
Berka 1993–1998 Czech context; revalidate on current book before policy use
Tiny segments (stressed/dormant) need caution — small-n instability
